capabilities: Render animated architecture, process, and data-flow diagrams from YAML
Embed diagrams in any note with flowmotion code blocks
Edit diagrams with autocomplete, error checks, and live preview
Draw flowchart, sequence, activity, state, mind map, Gantt, C4, class, and ER diagrams
Match diagrams to light and dark themes
extras: Optional draw.io and Monaco add-ons download on first enable (network needed once); draw.io editor is desktop-only and served via a local server on 127.0.0.1. README advises testing in a copy of the vault; mobile and optional-editor workflows still need manual checks.
problem: Diagrams in notes are static, so readers cannot watch requests travel through services, see where work waits, or spot bottlenecks at a glance.

relations.evidence: Use the familiar Mermaid or PlantUML style.
Use the familiar Mermaid or PlantUML style.
The optional draw.io editor is downloaded from its upstream project when you turn it on
enable Settings → FlowMotion → Rich Code Editor (Monaco) for completion, hover help, and navigation
FlowMotion uses CodeMirror for .flow files and the diagram edit window.

summary: Obsidian plugin that renders animated, event-driven architecture, process, and data-flow diagrams from YAML in flowmotion code blocks, fully offline.
